exercises.hint: args.indexOf("--name") finds the flag; the value is the next item. If the flag is missing, default to "stranger".
exercises.task: Simulate a tiny CLI: finish greet(args) so it reads a --name flag from an args array (like process.argv) and prints a greeting. Default to "stranger" if the flag is missing.

exercises.hint: Drop the leading "v", split on ".", and compare the first number against 18.
exercises.task: Many tools check process.version before running. Write isNode18Plus(version) which takes a string like "v20.11.0" and returns true if the major version is 18 or higher.
